name: io.github.liudejua27-blip/fitmeet
title: 引力AI · Yinli AI
description: Yinli AI (引力AI, formerly FitMeet) is the SI (Social Intelligence)-native human connection and instant-messaging network — putting people at the center while Agents apply social intelligence to understand intent, trust, context and boundaries, then connect people who would otherwise never meet. A persistent identity and consented network carry the relationship into an ongoing conversation.
